pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal regions with rounded vertices. Edge transitions exhibit smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp angularity. Geometric area is maximal on the mid-flank and reduces significantly toward the lower neck and ventral boundary.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space web with consistent pixel thickness across the flank. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent and tetravalent, creating a stable topological mesh. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible field.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the neck and shoulder ridge. The silhouette displays a uniform, fine-textured bristle pattern against the background.
